reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000096 (the melody read from 000096a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, 1 note off in 14); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Thomas Este has no death year on CCEH's page or ours; their work is dated 1592, before 1850, so they died before 1955 (they would have been over 105). George Kirbye's dates (died 1634) are from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/George_Kirbye (c. 1565 - buried 6 October 1634; arranged tunes for East's Whole Booke of Psalmes, 1592); CCEH's page gives none. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000096a.nwc).
